description_en: You can call the DescribeRDDomainConfig operation to query the feature configurations of your domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeRDDomainConfig查询用户RD下的域名功能配置
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-rd-domain-config --domain-name example.com --function-name source_group --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRDDomainConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the feature. If you do not specify this parameter, the configurations of the source\_group feature are queried
parameters.help_zh: 功能名称，默认查询源站组（source_group）功能
parameters.name: function_name
